title: FlowMe P25 production decision matrix for P26
reason: P25 contains working execution primitives, but date intent, recurring-series export, memo segmentation, and public-route handoff do not yet share one predictable contract.

decisions.decision: Keep source content immutable and store personal edits as an overlay.
decisions.why: This preserves source traceability while allowing private execution changes.

decisions.decision: Keep the post-save whole-Flow receipt pattern used by vehicle and source-backed Flow Maps.
decisions.why: It provides item count, complete artifact confirmation, and a deliberate next action.

decisions.decision: Keep scope-first export with visible destination counts.
decisions.why: Flow whole and selected exports were predictable and output counts matched for non-routine flows.

decisions.decision: Keep the wide Calendar rail, month grid, and selected-day agenda.
decisions.why: It uses wide space purposefully and supports undated-to-dated scheduling.

decisions.decision: Keep deterministic memo parsing without AI generation for P26.
decisions.why: The current trust boundary is appropriate; parsing and review quality can improve without adding provider, privacy, or cost risk.

decisions.decision: Keep completion state reversible and occurrence-specific.
decisions.why: Current production can complete and reopen recurring occurrences without changing the series definition.

decisions.decision: Make date intent an explicit three-state choice: schedule now, keep undated, preview only.
decisions.why: A blank date currently saves an example anchor as a real schedule.

decisions.decision: Route every public save through one canonical receipt and whole-Flow handoff.
decisions.why: The moving-specific CTA bypasses the receipt while other public routes use it.

decisions.decision: Define one recurrence contract for definition, generated occurrence, completion, and ICS.
decisions.why: Public ICS exports a recurring event while the saved My Flow exports zero calendar events.

decisions.decision: Turn memo splitting into a reviewable clause parser with visible source-to-item mapping.
decisions.why: One non-matching clause prevents an otherwise actionable comma list from splitting.

decisions.decision: Make whole Flow a phase-grouped plan outline, not a long list of full-control rows.
decisions.why: The 24-item moving Flow repeats open and memo controls across a very long mobile surface.

decisions.decision: Separate quick edit from advanced schedule editing and use a contained mobile sheet.
decisions.why: Inline advanced fields compete with Flow structure, reordering, completion, export, and global navigation.

decisions.decision: Rename the My Flow subview from '내 Flow' to '전체 Flow' or 'Flow 목록'.
decisions.why: The page and one of its tabs currently have the same label but different scopes.

decisions.decision: Unify Flow, selected, and current-item export into one scope vocabulary and preview.
decisions.why: Current-item export lives in detail while whole and selected scopes live in a separate panel.

decisions.decision: Group same-day Calendar items by Flow in the agenda and preserve full titles outside the grid.
decisions.why: Color and initials distinguish flows, but month cells truncate titles and make comparisons difficult.

decisions.decision: Remove example dates from the persisted execution record unless the user explicitly confirms them.
decisions.why: Preview data must not become personal schedule data implicitly.

decisions.decision: Remove recurring series definitions from the undated Calendar tray.
decisions.why: Definitions are not unscheduled work and duplicate the generated occurrence visually.

decisions.decision: Remove route-specific save CTAs that use a different destination or label.
decisions.why: Moving has a special CTA to /my while the canonical public CTA uses /my?savedFlow=... .

decisions.decision: Remove persistent primary-surface prose that only explains controls already represented structurally.
decisions.why: Copy should preserve safety and source context, not compensate for unclear action hierarchy.

decisions.decision: Compare a phase outline default with an optional timeline view for long Flow plans.
decisions.why: Moving requires both sequence comprehension and executable rows; one presentation need not carry both at once.

decisions.decision: Test batch scheduling as a tray-to-calendar preview with a single commit.
decisions.why: Date-less work is useful when it behaves as an inbox, but users need to see how many items and dates will change before commit.

decisions.decision: Add a post-export receipt that previews row/event count and destination semantics.
decisions.why: Counts are present before action but routine contradictions show that result-level confirmation is still needed.

decisions.decision: Defer direct Google Calendar, Notion, Obsidian, and todo API connections until export contracts are stable.
decisions.why: An integration would amplify current date and recurrence inconsistencies.

decisions.decision: Defer AI memo generation and URL content generation.
decisions.why: P26 should first make deterministic intake, review, persistence, and export trustworthy.

decisions.decision: Defer account sync, server persistence, collaboration, and full version history.
decisions.why: Local execution semantics and migration-safe identity must be closed before adding distributed state.

apply: Explicit undated inbox separate from dated calendar
Project or itinerary receipt after import
Quick edit separated from advanced recurrence controls
Occurrence completion separate from repeating template
adapt: Today planning because FlowMe also needs source sequence and relative dates
Calendar drag-and-drop because FlowMe must preserve anchor-relative and fixed overrides
Template duplication because FlowMe retains source trace and personal overlay
doNotApply: A full replacement planner information architecture
Dense professional calendar controls on mobile
